claims: HUNTR/X is a fictional K-pop group in the Netflix film KPop Demon Hunters.
EJAE provides the singing voice for Rumi in the Netflix film KPop Demon Hunters.
Audrey Nuna provides the singing voice for Mira in the Netflix film KPop Demon Hunters.
Rei Ami provides the singing voice for Zoey in the Netflix film KPop Demon Hunters.
The characters in the Netflix film KPop Demon Hunters balance K-pop stardom with supernatural demon hunting.
The characters in the Netflix film KPop Demon Hunters perform the song "Golden".
